meta.description: What is near you right now that you would want to know about? Friends in town, meetups in your languages, local posts — without tracking.
footer.lens: Kafumu is a lens on public, local information. Your location is turned into a coarse #geo cell on your device; coordinates never leave it.
home.finding: Finding your cell… (only a ~5 km area is computed, on your device)
about.title: What is Kafumu?
about.intro: Kafumu answers one question: what is near me right now that I would want to know about? Friends you've met who happen to be in town, meetups in a language you speak or a hobby you have, and what people around here are saying.
about.geo_1: Your device turns your position into the first six characters of its plus code, for example #geo9f469v for central Amsterdam or #geo8ccgqw for Parque das Nações in Lisbon. That is an area of about 5.5 × 5.5 km. Coordinates never leave your device; only the cell does.
about.geo_2: Because a cell is just a word, “what's near me” becomes a hashtag search that works on any network. Add #geo… to a Bluesky post and everyone nearby using Kafumu can see it — no account here needed.
about.private: Private things (people you've scanned, their contact details) stay on your device. Public things live on public networks you control. The Kafumu server keeps only what it must, and most of that expires within days. We can't leak what we don't have.
about.free: Finding people, friends nearby, and hosting meetups will always be free. Kafumu is run by one person; if it helps you meet someone, you'll be able to chip in.

account.title: Your account
account.why: You don't need an account to look around. You need one to host meetups and to have a name others can find.
account.what_we_keep: No email, no phone number. We keep a random id, a hash of your sign-in key, and the name you choose. Delete it any time.
account.created: Your account is ready. Save the link below — it is the only way back in on another device.
account.link_explain: Open this link on any device to sign in. Keep it private, like a password. Save it in your password manager or send it to yourself.
account.delete_confirm: Delete your account? This can't be undone.
card.title: My card
card.explain: This is what you hand to someone you meet: scan each other's code and you both keep the other's card. Fill in only what you want to share.
card.about_placeholder: e.g. open source, Esperanto, robotics — up for coffee
card.private_note: Your card is stored only on this device. Kafumu's server never sees it; it travels encrypted to the people you scan.
js.no_storage: This browser won't let Kafumu store data. Try installing it to your home screen or leaving private mode.
